core_style.default_register: casual - often uses slang and informal phrases
core_style.sentence_shape: clipped fragments - frequently speaks in short, punchy statements
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick to jump between thoughts and topics
core_style.two_registers: rarely shifts to a more serious tone when addressing authority figures, contrasting with his usual playful demeanor

humor.style: absurdist - often finds humor in the ridiculousness of situations
humor.frequency: constant - humor is a staple in most interactions
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - sets up expectations only to twist them unexpectedly

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames situations and people for comedic effect, revealing a playful attitude towards authority
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more earnest and direct, often using longer sentences when he feels vulnerable
structural_patterns: frequently uses 'I didn't do it' as a defense
starts sentences with 'Hey, man,' when addressing authority figures
often ends sentences with 'or what?' to challenge others

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: none - uses everyday language without specialized vocabulary
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent interruptions and exclamations, often trailing off or changing topics abruptly

worldview.value of freedom: believes in the importance of personal freedom and rebellion against authority, often acting impulsively to assert this belief
worldview.value of family: values his family despite their dysfunction, often expressing a desire for their support even while acting out

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a misunderstood rebel fighting against the system
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often reveals himself to be insecure and seeking validation from his parents and peers
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: deflects with humor or bravado when confronted about his shortcomings

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses sarcasm and humor to mask vulnerability, often making jokes to deflect serious conversations
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes stammered and hesitant, often using shorter sentences and a higher pitch
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to simple, direct statements, often showing a lack of energy or enthusiasm
emotional_tells.when_in_control: displays confidence through assertive speech, often using commanding language and humor to dominate the conversation

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to banter or joke to deflect the situation, but may resort to fleeing if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and humor, often challenging their authority openly
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more serious and protective, often showing a willingness to stand up for them
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: typically redirects the conversation or makes a joke to avoid admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, escalates to sarcasm, and may end in defiance or retreat if challenged
conversation_goals: seek validation from peers and family

relationship_matrix.HOMER: father - desires approval but often feels misunderstood

expert: pranks and mischief - shows a deep understanding of how to navigate trouble

ignorant: emotional intelligence - often misses cues about others' feelings and needs

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a cool, rebellious figure
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often viewed as a troublemaker and underachiever by adults
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desire for acceptance and the reality of being an outcast causes frustration
